title: French Meme Song
blurb: Accordion-adjacent and jaunty, capable of relocating any clip to Paris regardless of where it was actually filmed. The internet reaches for it whenever something achieves Continental absurdity — a mime, a baguette carried at an angle, an elegant failure conducted with unwarranted dignity. Anybody being theatrically European in a way that would be embarrassing in English also qualifies. It is an entire aesthetic delivered in about eight seconds, and it does more scene-setting than a caption ever could. Oui oui. Press the button and the video acquires a small moustache.
origin: The jaunty tune of French-flavored meme edits.
